Package org.apache.juneau.console.bus

Class BusRefusal

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
org.apache.juneau.console.bus.BusRefusal
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class BusRefusal extends Exception
A named refusal from the bus: the session POST's 400/403/429/501 answers and the codec's bus:bad-frame. The message is fixed server text; denied() lists the topic names the caller requested, which is the only caller input in a refusal.
Example:

try { BusSession s = bus.openSession(req, body); ... } catch (BusRefusal e) { res.setStatus(e.status()); e.retryAfterSeconds().ifPresent(s -> res.setHeader("Retry-After", String.valueOf(s))); return e.toJson(); // {"code":"bus:topic-denied","message":"...","denied":["ops.secret"]} }

Since:
10.0.0
